theme_and_archetype.name: Hybrid Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) + 6 (Vibrant Play)
theme_and_archetype.description: Friendly, approachable, and accessible. Designed for a youth robotics team. Focuses on clarity, generous spacing, and a non-cyberpunk, non-intimidating aesthetic. Fully supports light and dark modes with a muted, eye-friendly dark mode (no pure black).

heading.description: Geometric, approachable, not overly childish. Used for all H1-H4. DO NOT USE INTER.

body.description: Excellent legibility and accessibility for chat logs and UI elements.

mono.description: For code snippets in the file sharing and programming chat.

colors.usage_rules: Strictly map these HSL values to the :root and .dark selectors in index.css. Dark mode uses dark slate (#12141A) instead of pure black for accessibility. Primary color is a friendly tech blue, secondary is an energetic yellow/orange for warnings and highlights.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. The user explicitly requested 'don't crowd everything into one page, space things out.'
layout_and_spacing.padding: Cards and containers MUST have p-6 or p-8. Sections must be separated by py-12 or py-16.
layout_and_spacing.gap: Use gap-6 or gap-8 for bento/grid layouts. Avoid tight gap-2 unless inside a dense chat feed.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-xl for a soft, approachable feel. Avoid sharp 0px corners.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard with span logic (e.g., md:grid-cols-3, main feed col-span-2, sidebar col-span-1). Use Flexbox for the chat interface (sidebar fixed width, chat area flex-grow).

customizations.cards: Subtle border (border-border), no harsh drop shadows. In light mode, shadow-sm is okay. In dark mode, rely on border and background contrast.
customizations.buttons: rounded-full or rounded-xl. Hover state must explicitly change background brightness. Primary buttons use bg-primary text-primary-foreground.
customizations.chat_bubbles: Incoming: bg-muted text-foreground. Outgoing: bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Generous p-4.
customizations.tabs: Use shadcn Tabs for switching between Programming / Building / Business / Team inside a Category (VEX / FRC).

pages_structure.login_register: Split screen layout. Left side: Friendly hero image with overlay and inspirational robotics quote. Right side: Login/Register form with Role selection (Member/Mentor/Owner) via Select dropdown. Avoid centered tiny box.
pages_structure.main_dashboard: Welcome banner (dynamic based on role). Quick summary cards (Next Event, New Files, Unread Messages). Not crowded.
pages_structure.chat_interface: App-like layout. Left Sidebar: Categories (VEX, FRC) as collapsible accordions. Channels underneath (Programming, Building, Business, Team). Private Section: Members-Only channel (hidden if role != member/owner). Main panel: Chat feed with input fixed at bottom.
pages_structure.file_sharing: Grid layout (bento style) for images. List layout for Code/Zip files. Upload button opens a Dialog.
pages_structure.calendar: Full-width calendar view using standard grid. Mentors/Owners see 'Add Event' button.
pages_structure.admin_profile: Settings layout with vertical tabs (Profile, Notifications, Team Members - for owner). Toggles for Email & Text notifications.

media.usage: Use these exact URLs. DO NOT use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com. Use the login_hero image for the left side of the authentication screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: data-testid='login-button', data-testid='chat-input'.
CRITICAL: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for main layout structures (sidebar, main content flexbox). Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dialog, Tabs, Select, Calendar, Dropdown).
Implement light and dark mode toggling using a standard theme provider toggling the 'dark' class on the HTML element.
DO NOT cram the chat, files, and calendar onto one page. Use react-router-dom to separate views, connected by the main sidebar navigation.

Role Based Access Control: The 'Members Only' chat link/route MUST NOT render if the current user's role is 'mentor'. The Owner role must be restricted to 1 user (handled in backend logic or mock state).
Avoid the generic 'Vercel' look. Use the specified 'Outfit' font for headings to give it a distinct team personality.
To handle 'Keep it spaced out', wrap main content areas in a container with max-w-7xl mx-auto and p-8.
Add hover and focus states (focus-visible:ring-2) to all interactive elements to pass accessibility standards.
